_doc: Target bands for the balance table (internal/game/balance.go): weapon -> "part/armor/dist[/through1]" (head|body|legs / none|vest|helmet / 5|15|30 m; through1: the target behind one body, penetration) -> shots [min, max] and/or ttkMs [min, max]. CS2 archetypes, then the operator's 2026-11 damage pass (pistols ~-30%, rifles ~-15%, SMG +15%: no pistol-round one-taps, no rifle one-tap through a helmet), then #14's pass (AK back to 36: the Prompt one-taps a helmet again, the Linter doesn't; the SMG loses armored fights); TestBalanceBands fails when the data leaves a band. Every weapon needs bands.
